entries.0e6379d364e4e169: In January 2022, it formulated a new five-year medium-term management plan with the fiscal year ending November 2026 as its final year, and is implementing measures aimed at stable and sustainable growth. It identifies its strength as meeting the individual needs of each customer by drawing on the 3PL know-how it has accumulated over many years, and states that it will continue to play a 'logistics concierge' role, going beyond storing customers' goods to propose solutions to logistics issues. Its management philosophy states: 'Provide customers with complete service,' 'Contribute to the improvement of citizens' lives through the development of the business,' and 'Commit to management that respects people,' and it aims to become a logistics company chosen by customers.
